2281-3305-8095.description:
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Body Launderer.
When Saffi dies, Body Launderer's first ability triggers, causing it to connive.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Body Launderer.
When Body Launderer dies, its second ability and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Body Launderer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Body Launderer trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4247-6871-6879-7223.description:
Cast Stalactite Dagger by paying {2}.
When Stalactite Dagger enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Shapeshifter creature token with changeling.
When the Shapeshifter enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Stalactite Dagger, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Stalactite Dagger.
When Stalactite Dagger dies, Haru triggers, returning Stalactite Dagger from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 once.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat from step 4.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a +1/+1 counter on it and not copying a Human

628-6797-7936.notablePrerequisites: You control a non-Human creature other than Dominion Saboteur that has a -1/-1 counter on it.
628-6797-7936.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Dominion Saboteur.
When Dominion Saboteur dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it. As it enters, choose to have it copy a non-Human you control with a -1/-1 counter on it, and then also enter with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

1429-4981-5231.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Lesser Masticore
When Lesser Masticore dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Lesser Masticore enters, Serra Redeemer triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Lesser Masticore
Repeat.

824-2728-4153-6797.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-4153-6797.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-4153-6797.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it.
When the creature dies, Resourceful Defense and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 4.

440-2275-7426-7743.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
440-2275-7426-7743.description:
Draw a card.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain life.
Well of Lost Dreams and Heroic Feast trigger.
Resolve the Heroic Feast trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Resolve the Well of Lost Dreams ability, causing you to pay {1} to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2

413-1417-2946-4871.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
413-1417-2946-4871.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Bridge from Below and Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
When the creature token enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cult Conscript enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station
Repeat.

698-4050-4182-7639.notablePrerequisites: You've gained 5 or more life this turn.
698-4050-4182-7639.description:
Activate Will by tapping it.
Cast Whispers of the Muse by paying {U} due to Will.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whispers of the Muse.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

4594-4924-7070.description:
Activate Spirit en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Spirit en-Kor.
The Spirit en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Spirit en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Heartless Summoning.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-3470-5702-6973.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
1270-3470-5702-6973.description:
Play a land.
When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create three token copies of Mutable Explorer.
When the Mutable Explorer tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the first Mutable Explorer trigger, creating a Mutavault land token that enters tapped.
When the Mutavault token enters, Springheart Nantuko and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating three 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Repeat from step 4 for the second trigger.
Repeat from step 4 for the third trigger, instead choosing to pay for Springheart Nantuko's trigger to create three token copies of Mutable Explorer.
Repeat from step 3.

4289-5051-5078-6766.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

339-677-1322-2511.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1170-1517-1750-6776.easyPrerequisites:
The Mirari Conjecture's third chapter ability has triggered this turn.
A nonland permanent left the battlefield this turn, or a spell was warped this turn.
1170-1517-1750-6776.description:
Cast Roving Actuator by paying {3}{R}.
When Roving Actuator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Pull from Eternity from your graveyard, and then copying it and casting the copy without paying its mana cost, targeting any card you own in exile.
Displacer Kitten and The Mirari Conjecture trigger, with Displacer Kitten targeting Roving Actuator.
Resolve the The Mirari Conjecture trigger, copying the Pull from Eternity spell, targeting the original Pull from Eternity.
Resolve the copy of the Pull from Eternity Spell from step 4, putting Pull from Eternity from exile into your graveyard.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Roving Actuator.
Repeat from step 2.

1591-2634-5259.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{R}.
1591-2634-5259.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rude Awakening by paying {4}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Rude Awakening.
Resolve the Rude Awakening copy, untapping all lands you control.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

643-1238-2351-3967-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Yahenni ability
Repeat.

2178-5231-5969-5970.notablePrerequisites:
Marina does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Marina.
Spiked Corridor is locked.
2178-5231-5969-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocked Spiked Corridor.
Spiked Corridor triggers, creating three 1/1 Devil creature tokens.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Devil, adding {R}.
When the Devil dies, it and Marina trigger.
Resolve the Devil's trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Marina trigger, untapping it.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Spiked Corridor.
Repeat steps 3 through 6 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

703-1308-3868.description:
Cast Astral Dragon by paying {6}{U}{U}.
When Astral Dragon enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating four token copies of Anointed Procession that are 3/3 Dragons.
Cast Prosperous Partnership by paying {1}{R}{W}.
When Prosperous Partnership enters the battlefield, it triggers creating 64 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Optionally, activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures, creating 32 Treasure tokens.
You may repeat step 5 as desired.

2034-2341-3683.notablePrerequisites:
An additional creature card with mana value less than the amount of life you've gained this turn in your graveyard.
Rodolf Duskbringer is not your commander.
You have gained at least 3 life this turn.
2034-2341-3683.description:
At the beginning of your end step, Rodolf Duskbringer triggers, allowing you to pay {1}{W/B}.
When you do, put Rodolf Duskbringer's ability on the stack targeting any creature in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate The Peregrine Dynamo by paying {1} and tapping it, targeting Rodolf Duskbringer's ability.
Holding priority again, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing The Peregrine Dynamo, adding {2}.
Resolve The Peregrine Dynamo's ability, copying Rodolf Duskbringer's ability targeting The Peregrine Dynamo.
Resolve the copied ability, returning The Peregrine Dynamo from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2034-2972-5003-5184.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ganax, adding {C}{C}.
Ganax dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Ganax from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Ganax enters the battlefield, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

742-1295-2890-3077-3944-4892.description:
Cast Flash, targeting Protean Hulk.
Protean Hulk dies on ETB, fetching Blood Pet, Spellseeker, and Thassa's Oracle.
Arrange the stack such that Spellseeker's trigger is on top, so that when it resolves, it fetches Demonic Consultation.
Cast Demonic Consultation by sacrificing Blood Pet, adding 1 black mana to your mana pool.
Make sure Demonic Consultation targets a card not in your library, causing you to exile your entire library.
Then, Thassa's Oracle ETB resolves, and since you have no library, you win the game.

813-1987-2510-3941.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
813-1987-2510-3941.description:
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Scholar of the Ages, blinking them.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.
